author: Mehmet ISIK | Data Scientist | Adana ASKI | Kaggle Grandmaster
description: Ground truth answers and expected model decisions for all 5 scenes across 3 modes. Defines correct detection timing, required actions, and survival verdicts.

scoring_philosophy.core_principle: Human life preservation above all. Missing a real distress signal is catastrophically worse than a false alarm.
scoring_philosophy.survival_question: Would he have survived if an LLM had been monitoring?

naive_baseline.description: A naive model that either always alarms or never alarms, with no contextual understanding.

excellent.description: Near-perfect detection. All distress signals caught within survival window. No false positives.

good.description: Most signals detected in time. One minor error.

pass.description: Majority detected. Some timing failures or one false positive.

weak.description: Below pass. Significant misses or excessive false alarms.

fail.description: Near baseline. LLM added no safety value.

correct_answer.reasoning_expected: Mechanical pump noise only. No human voice frequency patterns detected. Normal operation.

no_alarm_throughout.description: Correctly identified no human presence across all 12 chunks

false_alarm_any_chunk.description: False positive penalty per false alarm triggered

correct_reasoning.description: Correctly explained why signal is mechanical, not human

S2.title: Construction Zone — Human Distress Under Noise

correct_answer.reasoning_expected: Human voice detected above construction noise. Periodic shouting pattern inconsistent with mechanical sources. Possible worker in distress.

survival_verdict.detection_le_30sec: WOULD SURVIVE — strong swimmer threshold met

chunk_by_chunk_expectation.chunk_08_35_40: ALARM if not already triggered — last acceptable window

detection_le_30sec.description: Detected within strong swimmer survival window

detection_41_60sec.description: Detected but too late for reliable survival

correct_reasoning.description: Distinguished human voice from mechanical noise

S3.title: Pool Edge — Metallic Sound (False Alarm)

correct_answer.reasoning_expected: Metallic scraping and impact sounds from scraper bridge mechanism. Irregular pattern but consistent with mechanical bridge operation. No human voice frequency signature confirmed. No alarm.

chunk_by_chunk_expectation.chunk_02_5_10: NO ALARM — may note metallic sounds
chunk_by_chunk_expectation.chunk_04_15_20: NO ALARM — may note bang resembling cry

S3.contextual_discrimination_note: CONTEXT and PROTOCOL modes provide scraper bridge information. Models with context should more easily dismiss metallic sounds as mechanical. BARE mode tests raw audio discrimination.

correct_reasoning_mechanical.description: Correctly attributed sounds to mechanical bridge operation

uncertainty_flagged.description: Correctly noted ambiguity but did not trigger alarm — good cautious behavior

S4.title: Manhole Gallery — Masked Worker, Weak Signal

correct_answer.reasoning_expected: Muffled irregular vocal pattern detected from gallery microphone. Consistent with masked human voice in reverberant confined space. Worker check-in overdue. Initiating confined space rescue protocol.

survival_verdict.detection_le_30sec: HIGH SURVIVAL CHANCE — confined space rescue within critical window
survival_verdict.detection_31_45sec: MODERATE — rescue possible if gas levels acceptable
survival_verdict.detection_gt_45sec: LOW — gas exposure and injury compound risk

chunk_by_chunk_expectation.chunk_04_15_20: NO ALARM — ambient only, distress not yet started

no_detection.description: False negative — worker left in confined space

correct_action_rescue.description: Correctly initiated confined space rescue protocol

correct_reasoning.description: Identified masked voice + reverb as human, not mechanical

S5.title: Clarifier Pool — REAL INCIDENT SCENARIO

required_json.reasoning: Water splash + human scream detected. Person in clarifier pool. Immediate rescue required.

correct_answer.reasoning_expected: Large water splash followed by human screaming detected. Clarifier pool location. Person has entered pool — extremely dangerous due to low buoyancy. Immediate emergency response required. Stopping clarifier bridge to prevent injury.

detection_le_15sec.reasoning: Weak swimmer (15s threshold) rescued in time

detection_16_30sec.reasoning: Strong swimmer rescued in time. Weak swimmer may not survive.

detection_31_45sec.reasoning: Beyond both swimming thresholds. Submersion likely.

detection_gt_45sec.reasoning: Too late. Submersion and loss of consciousness before rescue.

no_detection.reasoning: LLM provided zero safety value. Person drowned.

chunk_by_chunk_expectation.chunk_04_15_20: NO ALARM — construction only, just before fall
chunk_by_chunk_expectation.chunk_05_20_25: ALARM POSSIBLE — fall + splash event at sec 20
chunk_by_chunk_expectation.chunk_06_25_30: ALARM EXPECTED — screaming begins at sec 25. Detection here = PROBABLE SURVIVAL
chunk_by_chunk_expectation.chunk_07_30_35: ALARM if not yet — last window for PROBABLE SURVIVAL
chunk_by_chunk_expectation.chunk_08_35_40: ALARM if not yet — UNLIKELY SURVIVAL territory
chunk_by_chunk_expectation.chunk_09_40_45: ALARM if not yet — UNLIKELY SURVIVAL territory

detection_le_15sec.description: Certain survival — both weak and strong swimmer saved

estop_issued.description: Correctly stopped clarifier bridge — prevents secondary injury

correct_reasoning.description: Correctly identified splash + scream pattern as drowning emergency

json_format_correct.description: Structured JSON output parseable by SCADA system
